C1144.title: Study on Identifying Suspicious NFT Trading
C1144.summary: On November 25, 2023, Imtiaz Sifat, Syed Ahzam Tariq, and Denise van Donselaar released a study of suspicious NFT trading online; the article later appeared in the January 2024 issue of Information & Management. The research treats manipulation in NFT transactions as an identification problem and examines how transaction data can distinguish suspicious activity, rather than equating every self-transfer between wallets with fraud.
